# Domain schema database/v0

Tables, columns, keys and constraints, and the relations between them; columns carry `data.type`. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/database/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/database/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/database/v0.json).

An extraction in this schema is an [extraction](extraction.md) whose `schema` is `database/v0`; the extraction schema applies this one
to it.

## Typed data

The engine checks every typed field, and reports a violation at its path. Other `data` fields are open JSON.

### Entities

| Kind | Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `column` | `data.type` | [`text`](extraction.md#text) | Yes | The column's type as the framework or source declares it, such as Prisma's `String` or Django's `CharField`. |
| `column` | `data.databaseType` | string or null |  | The column's native database type with its arguments, such as `varchar(200)`; null or absent when unknown. |
| `column` | `data.nullable` | boolean |  | Whether the column accepts null. |
| `column` | `data.primaryKey` | boolean |  | Whether the column is (part of) its table's primary key. |
| `constraint` | `data.type` | string |  | The kind of constraint, such as `primary-key`, `unique` or `foreign-key`. |
| `constraint` | `data.table` | string |  | The constrained table's label, when no relationship connects them. |
| `constraint` | `data.columns` | array of string |  | The constrained columns, by label. |
| `primary-key` | `data.table` | string |  | The keyed table's label, when no relationship connects them. |
| `primary-key` | `data.columns` | array of string |  | The key columns, by label. |

### Relationships

| Kind | Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `foreign-key`, `relation` | `data.columns` | array of string |  | The dependent table’s columns, by label, when the relationship connects tables. |
| `foreign-key`, `relation` | `data.principalColumns` | array of string |  | The referenced columns, by label, in the order of `columns`. |
